solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Journalist cycled over carrying it

indicators.note: carrying means the reversed ride word holds the next piece within it
over signals the word for cycled is turned round to read backwards

parts.note: to have cycled is to have rode a bike, so rode
taken as written

explanation.surface: A reporter pedalled across town with something on the handlebars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cycled' looks like part of the surface story of a ride, but it supplies the past tense of riding a bike.
explanation.definitionFit: A newspaper's senior figure who shapes copy is a kind of journalist.

clue.text: Power shown by champion dog, race's early leader

parts.note: P is the standard abbreviation for power in physics
an ace is a top performer, a champion
a setter is a breed of gundog

explanation.surface: A powerful prize-winning greyhound sets the pace at the start of a race.
explanation.definitionFit: The runner who sets the speed at the front early in a race is called by this compound term.

clue.text: Spots name inside card

indicators.note: inside means the letter for name goes within the word for the card

parts.note: an ace is a playing card

explanation.surface: Dots appear on the face of a playing card bearing a name.
explanation.definitionFit: Spots are pimples on the skin, the skin condition being the collective term.

clue.text: Strong macho types kept in check

indicators.note: kept in means the macho men are held within the word for check

parts.note: to vet something is to check it over
he-men are macho, muscular types

explanation.surface: Tough guys are held back under close scrutiny.
explanation.definitionFit: Strong feelings or protests can be described as forceful and passionate, a synonym.

clue.text: Round of applause before dance that's kind of foul

indicators.note: before places the applause word ahead of the dance word

parts.note: give them a big hand means a round of applause
a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: Clapping greets a party, though something underhand happens.
explanation.walkthrough: In football, touching the ball with the hand is a foul by this name.
explanation.definitionFit: Deliberately touching the ball with the arm in football is an offence of this type.

clue.text: Devious mate's pocketing your old gemstone

indicators.note: pocketing means the rearranged letters take the old word for your inside them
devious suggests something twisted, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: thy is the archaic form of your

explanation.surface: A crafty friend slips your old jewel into a pocket.
explanation.walkthrough: The possessive 's of 'mate's' counts as a letter here, giving five letters to rearrange around the old pronoun.
explanation.definitionFit: This purple quartz is prized as a semi-precious gem.

clue.text: Lots terribly low after workers suffered a heavy defeat

indicators.note: after puts the word for low behind the workers
terribly suggests the letters of lots are badly jumbled

parts.note: hands are workers, as in farmhands
down means low in spirits

explanation.surface: Lots of badly paid, dispirited workers took a beating.
explanation.definitionFit: To be beaten easily and decisively is an idiom for being thrashed.

clue.text: Keen to embrace that woman in bright red

indicators.note: to embrace means the word for keen wraps around the pronoun

parts.note: to keen is to wail or cry in grief
her refers to that woman

explanation.surface: Eager to hug a woman wearing scarlet.
explanation.definitionFit: A vivid red colour is named after the fruit of that shade.

clue.text: Fleece man on board

definitions.meaning: to fleece is to swindle or cheat someone
a chess piece, a castle, is a man on the board

explanation.definitionFit: Both a slang verb for cheating and a chess piece share this name.

clue.text: Little bit of dough adds about middle

parts.note: dough is slang for money, and a cent is a small coin
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A baker adds a small portion of dough to the centre of the tin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dough' suggests baking but means money here.
explanation.definitionFit: The middle of something is its central point, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Bones from Wounded Knee? Lots

indicators.note: wounded suggests damage, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Many remains were found at the site of the Wounded Knee massacre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wounded' rearranges KNEE and LOTS together; Wounded Knee is the 1890 massacre site in South Dakota.
explanation.definitionFit: The whole framework of bones in a body is called by this term.

clue.text: Public school to plan residence welcoming the Queen

indicators.note: welcoming means the royal abbreviation is taken in between the other pieces

parts.note: to chart is to map out or plan
a house is a residence
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen

explanation.surface: A grand school sets out a plan for a house fit to receive royalty.
explanation.walkthrough: Charterhouse is a well-known fee-paying English school in Surrey; in Britain 'public school' means a private one.
explanation.definitionFit: It is one of the old English independent schools, called public schools in Britain.

clue.text: Duel arranged — relaxed Burton's kept calm

indicators.note: kept means the rearranged duel letters hold the other jumble inside them
arranged means the letters of duel are put in a new order
relaxed suggests the letters of the name loosen and shift

parts.note: the surname Burton taken as written, the possessive adding no letter

explanation.surface: Burton stayed relaxed when a duel was set up, and kept his cool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' turns DUEL into U...LED, 'relaxed' turns BURTON into NTROUB, and 'kept' puts the second inside the first; the dash makes 'kept calm' look like one phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone undisturbed and free from worry can be described as calm, a synonym.

clue.text: Deliveries for doormen

definitions.meaning: in cricket, bowled balls are deliveries, and short ones rising sharply have this name
men on the door of a club who eject troublemakers

explanation.definitionFit: Short rising balls in cricket and nightclub door staff share this name.

clue.text: White wine — some bucellas tippled

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone drank a little of the Portuguese white wine Bucellas.
explanation.definitionFit: This sparkling Italian wine from Piedmont is a white.

clue.text: Disrespectful, lacking foresight right away

indicators.note: away means the letter for right is taken out

parts.note: imprudent means unwise, lacking foresight

explanation.surface: Being rude and short-sighted, someone is sent packing at once.
explanation.walkthrough: 'right away' reads as 'at once' but splits into R and the deletion signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Being cheeky and showing no respect is a synonym.

clue.text: Opinion expressed by soldiers evicted from apartment building

indicators.note: evicted from means the soldiers are thrown out of the building

parts.note: a tenement is a block of flats
men is a crossword word for soldiers, the ranks

explanation.surface: Squaddies thrown out of a block of flats voice their view.
explanation.definitionFit: A principle or belief someone holds is a synonym for an opinion.

clue.text: Hear about old system of weights

indicators.note: about means the judge's word goes around the abbreviation for old

parts.note: a judge will hear or try a case

explanation.surface: Listen to talk on an ancient way of measuring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hear' looks like a sound-alike signal but means try, as a court hears a case.
explanation.definitionFit: Troy weight is a traditional system used for precious metals and gems.

clue.text: Splits up firm producing vehicle components?

definitions.meaning: to go separate ways, as a couple does
read literally, a company that makes car parts

explanation.surface: A car-parts maker breaks up.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to separate, while the literal reading describes a spares supplier.

clue.text: Conditional release initially playing a part

indicators.note: initially means only the first letter of playing is used

parts.note: a role is a part in a play

explanation.surface: An actor on early release takes on a role.
explanation.definitionFit: Freeing a prisoner early on condition of good behaviour is this term.

clue.text: Duty on one vehicle

parts.note: a duty is a tax
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A levy is charged on a single car.
explanation.definitionFit: A cab for hire is a type of vehicle.

clue.text: Dance enthusiast circling with energy

indicators.note: circling means the enthusiast word goes around the word for with

parts.note: a fan is an enthusiast
and means with, as in bread and butter
go means energy, as in full of go

explanation.surface: A keen dancer spins round with vigour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is easy to read as a link word, but here it supplies its own letters.
explanation.definitionFit: This lively Spanish dance in triple time is a dance by name.

clue.text: Japanese drama about a Hebrew patriarch

indicators.note: about means the drama's name goes around the letter a

parts.note: Noh is the classical masked drama of Japan

explanation.surface: A Japanese play is about a biblical figure.
explanation.walkthrough: Noh is classical Japanese masked drama.
explanation.definitionFit: The builder of the ark is one of the Old Testament patriarchs.

clue.text: Bishop with book in bed

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
to book something is to order it in advance

explanation.surface: A bishop lies in bed with a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bed' looks like somewhere to sleep, but it is a flower bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A strip of garden planted with flowers is a bed of this kind.

clue.text: Capital city, captured by Cézanne, I viewed reflectively

indicators.note: reflectively means the letters are read as in a mirror, backwards
captured by means the letters are held within the following words

explanation.surface: A painter's view of a city, seen in a reflection.
explanation.walkthrough: The run ANNEIV sits inside 'Cézanne, I viewed'; 'reflectively' turns it to give the city.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the capital of Austria.

clue.text: Unnecessary to sew fringes of skirts

parts.note: to needle can mean to sew with a needle

indicators.note: fringes of means only the outer letters of skirts are used

explanation.surface: There is no point sewing the hems of skirts.
explanation.definitionFit: Something not required at all is a synonym for unnecessary.
